title: Lumina — Data & Marketing Analytics Platform
subtitle: Lumina delivers data-driven visibility, predictive marketing analytics, and executive dashboards for early-stage and scaling ventures operating in high-complexity markets.

sections.heading: Predictive Data Architecture
sections.body: Lumina translates raw operational data and market signals into actionable decision metrics. By combining Big Data patterns with automated KPI tracking, Lumina gives venture leaders real-time control over growth performance, customer acquisition dynamics, and capital velocity.

sections.heading: Core Capabilities
sections.body:
`• **Attribution & Unit Economics:** Continuous tracking of CLV, CAC, and unit margin health.`

`• **Automated Compliance & Audit Trail:** Built-in governance reporting tailored for regulated domains.`

`• **Executive Dashboards:** Clean, high-impact visual models designed for board oversight and investor reporting.`

``
